name.description: Display name of the microsite (admin reference and default header title)

path_prefix.description: URL path prefix (single lowercase segment, e.g. 'summit'); pages are served at /{path_prefix}/{page-slug}

is_active.description: Whether the microsite is live; inactive microsites 404 publicly

logo_url.description: Optional microsite logo; falls back to the tenant header logo when empty

header_config.description: Header chrome overrides merged over the tenant header_config (gradientStops, topNav colors, logo sizing, etc.)

footer_config.description: Footer chrome overrides merged over the tenant footer_config (gradientColors, textColor, etc.)

home_page_id.description: Optional IEditPage ID served at /{path_prefix} (the microsite landing page)
